io_lowest_candidate_hint.invariant: Every mirror slot below hint is not-1, including reserved-3/-4; this is a mirror invariant, not a claim the kernel still holds the old descriptor.
io_lowest_candidate_hint.transitions: Registration=0; successful assign advances past its found lowest hole, failed FILES_UPDATE leaves it unchanged; successful release/direct-close lowers by min(hint,slot). Accept never needs to lower it because it only occupies slots. Pending unobserved accepts block assign.
io_lowest_candidate_hint.out_of_order: Accept-first reuse of closing-3 becomes-4, then old close becomes-2 without a free transition. Close-first creates-1 and lowers hint, pending accept blocks assign until accept occupies it. Both preserve conservative lower bound.
io_lowest_candidate_hint.complexity_limit: Continuous assign-only fill scan N(N+1)/2->N. No global amortized-O1 claim for arbitrary accept/hole interleavings: accept may repeatedly fill a low hole before assign scans. Free-slot count cannot identify lowest free index without stored position or rescanning.
io_lowest_candidate_hint.conclusion: No new correctness counterexample found; one private hint is simpler than an allocated freelist and preserves lowest-slot semantics.

apple_sink_next_batch_design.schema: Only plain dense F32 Q/K/V BSHD, B1/H64or128/KVheads1/D512; additive F32 mask[Q,KV], F32 sinks[H]; Q/KV>0; positive finite scale. No causal flag: the supplied mask already encodes causality/cache selection. Current ordinary helpers are bypassed.
apple_sink_next_batch_design.exact_math: F32 q=scale*Q; GQA unflatten Q heads and expand K/V; F32 QK then add unscaled additive mask. Broadcast each raw per-head sink as ONE extra score column; concatenate sink BEFORE precise softmax. Slice the sink probability column off, then F32 PV with original V. Sink participates only in denominator, never scales mask/sink or adds a V row.
apple_sink_next_batch_design.suggested_minimal_implementation: Keep original short/no-benefit call. Add a small private Sink block wrapper reusing kAttentionQueryBlock=16; per block call the SAME mx::fast::scaled_dot_product_attention(...,"array",mask_slice,sinks,false,stream). Locked D512 rejects both vector/full fusion for every block including tail, so this directly reuses the exact original fallback, avoiding a second softmax/sink implementation or native patch.
apple_sink_next_batch_design.views_and_order: Transpose full Q/K/V to BHSD once as today. Slice Q axis2 [begin,end), caller mask axis0 [begin,end) with full KV and shared original K/V/sinks. Sequence BOTH Q and mask source slices through depends(...,{previous_block_output}); concatenate block outputs on axis2 then original transpose to BSHD. No eval/sync/host payload inspection or new ownership/runtime. Rebind all five input owners must remain dynamic.
apple_sink_next_batch_design.mask_semantics: Do not regenerate a local causal mask or trim K/V. Slicing original global mask rows preserves its KV-fullQ+globalQ offset, sparse cache selection and nonfinite entries. All -Inf key logits plus finite sink must yield zero output. Preserve original NaN/Inf behavior by calling the original fallback.
apple_sink_next_batch_design.guard: Same conservative policy as ordinary math: Q>=1024, (Q-16)*KV>2*Q*512 with int64 arithmetic; schema already guarantees nonempty/F32/shape. Use KV rather than KV+1 as a conservative savings estimate; avoid any new short-Q expansion or user option.
